title: bug: #4905 change shiki theme to github-light
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Changes the theme of shiki to github-light in order to propertly show all text with the light background
another way around could be to change the code block background to a darker one,
please let me know if you prefer it that way.

Resolves #4905

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Changing this will break the site in dark mode. We should set the value based on the dark/light mode that the site is using. You can refer the vitepress documentation to figure out how this can be done.

comments.author: raiman264
comments.body: Thanks @sidharthv96 I just found the option and updated the PR :)

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies a bug (breaking dark mode) and requests a concrete change: setting the theme value dynamically based on dark/light mode, referencing VitePress documentation as a guide for implementation.
